title: The Last Hand

murder.device: the cuckoo clock was torn from the wall

intro.t: He died in the Card Room at 22:00, when the cuckoo clock was torn from the wall. Whoever was in that room at 22:00 is the killer.

intro.h: Four people were snowed in at the lodge.
intro.t: Astrid the guide, Birger the sauna keeper, Conrad the clerk and Dagny the barmaid. After the row over the accounts nobody would share a room. Four people, four rooms: every room was taken at every hour.

Between chimes there is only time to walk through one door, or to stay put. The lodge is built in a ring, so every room has two doors. Rebuild the night hour by hour, and find out who was in the Card Room at 22:00.

reasons.occupied: After the quarrel, nobody would share a room.
reasons.far: There is only time for one door per chime.

clues.lead: The cards are still on the table.
clues.text: At 21:00 the guide was playing cards with Mr. Holm in the Card Room.
clues.hint: Tap the Guide, then tap the Card Room.

clues.text: At 21:00 the keeper was in the Sauna, pouring water on the stones.
clues.hint: Another fixed point. Place the Keeper at 21:00.

clues.text: The barmaid never set foot in the Ski Room.
clues.hint: Two rooms and two people are left at 21:00. Which room can the Barmaid have?

clues.text: Between 21:00 and 22:00 the barmaid stayed in the same room.
clues.hint: She stayed put. Switch to 22:00 and place her.

clues.lead: The keeper hates the cold rooms.
clues.text: He never set foot in the Ski Room or the Card Room.
clues.hint: Look at 22:00. Which room is left for the Keeper?

clues.lead: A tray of drinks was set down in a hurry.
clues.text: Between 22:00 and 23:00 the clerk and the barmaid swapped rooms.
clues.hint: They traded places through one door. Where was the Barmaid at 22:00?

ending: 21:00 · The guide plays cards with Mr. Holm. The clerk waxes skis, the barmaid minds the Bar, and the keeper stokes the sauna.
The guide leaves the table for the Ski Room. Conrad the clerk passes her in the doorway.
22:00 · “You have been cooking the books.” The cuckoo clock is torn from the wall. Mr. Holm is dead, and the clerk is alone with him.
The clerk slips into the Bar as the barmaid carries a tray of drinks into the Card Room.
23:00 · The barmaid drops the tray and screams.
closing: The clerk was alone with Mr. Holm when the clock fell.
